title: Select courses to maximize total credits (at most K)
description_html:
Given n courses, each with a start time, an end time, and a credit value, select at most K courses whose time intervals do not overlap, to maximize the total credits. Return the maximum achievable total.

Input

  • start[], end[], credit[] (length n), and integer K.

Output

One integer: the maximum total credits from at most K non-overlapping courses.

Example

courses (start, end, credit):
  A = (1, 3, 3)
  B = (4, 6, 4)
  C = (2, 5, 8)
K = 2
----
8

A & B don't overlap (3 + 4 = 7), but C alone (8) beats any non-overlapping pair, since C overlaps both A and B. So with K = 2 the best is 8 — note picking the most courses (A+B) is NOT optimal.

This is weighted interval scheduling with a cardinality cap — equivalent to LeetCode 1751. See Notes for the DP, the trio, and references.
